std_narrative.citation:
William John Battersby (age 78) died on 22 April 1945 in the Leeds Burmantofts registration district and was cremated on 25 April 1945 at Lawnswood Cemetery & Crematorium, Leeds, Yorkshire, England. His occupation was clerk in Holy Orders. He was a widower. His ashes were removed to be interred at Penshaw church, Co. Durh. The cremation was applied for by Felix John Battersby (executor) of Watendlath, Tinshill Lane, Horsforth. '''Cremation''': "Yorkshire Burials"
